reason: Honestly I'd maybe download the free version if the bank linking really fills everything in, but I've quit every tracker within two weeks, so paying for Pro before I even know I'll still be opening it is not happening. My PhonePe history already tells me where the money went when I bother to look.
objection: I'll stop opening it after two weeks like every other app, and linking my bank account to a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews feels risky.
would_change_my_mind: If I used the free version for a month without quitting and it actually stopped my salary vanishing by the 20th, I'd pay the Rs 99.
